ns2:course.label: Seminar Theory of Knowledge
ns2:course.description: Selected topics and writings of major importance in the contemporary philosophy of knowledge. Approved for letter grading when offered for 4 hours; approved for S/U grading when offered for 2 hours - only available for Stage 3 Philosophy PhD students. May be repeated in the same or separate term. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor for non-philosophy graduate students.
